instruction: Search for Star Wars toys for boys and organize results from cheapest to most expensive.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Star Wars toys for boys on kohls.com and sorting by price low-high. Similar to original Spider-Man task with different franchise. Uses existing check_direct_json_object evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator covers all instruction requirements: searches for Star Wars toys for boys and verifies price sorting from low to high
Getter logic correctly extracts breadcrumb navigation items (Star Wars, Toys, Boys) and sort selection (Price Low-High) from HTML
URL parameter checks provide additional verification for search filters and sort parameter (S=4 for price low-high)
Metric correctly compares extracted data against expected values using case-insensitive matching
Expected values are semantically correct: all filters should be present (star wars, toys, boys, price low-high) and no unexpected filters should exist (is_other_exist=false)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts boolean flags for each filter, metric compares them key-by-key against expected values
